css_contract.rule: Exactly these two linked stylesheets in this order. Do not embed replacement Practice CSS or add a third ordinary stylesheet.

ordinary_practice_dom.hard_rule: The local qnum and beginning of the prompt are in the same first visible paragraph. A number-only paragraph followed by a second prompt paragraph fails.

title: Use the existing practice_set.css h1: plain navy text with thick 4px navy rule underneath; no filled title card.
tables: Ordinary two-column value/data tables use `values compact-table` and a two-column colgroup with `half-col` classes.

representations.caption: No descriptive student-facing figcaption.
representations.answer_neutrality: NEVER SHOW THE ANSWER IN THE STUDENT IMAGE.

cyu.layout: six exact items in `.cyu-grid`, 3 rows x 2 columns via existing CSS
cyu.same_prompt_rule: qnum + prompt share the same first visible paragraph

hard_rules: Do not redesign Practice; current live practice_set.css is visual authority.
Prompt precedes representation; representation precedes workspace.
CYU does not use per-question ws-50.
Required diagrams/graphs/tables are actually rendered; metadata alone does not count.
Do not invoke the graph tool downstream.
Student pages show no answers, teacher annotations, DOK/Bloom, or visible Bank-family metadata.
